text:
maya: Quick sync — doing one last sweep before the catalog launch tomorrow. I need a one-line status for any models you own: license cleared, perf profile (pass/fail/missing), infra readiness, and any blockers. Drop it here so I can compile a handoff doc.

owen: cedar-7b — owner: @owen. License: Apache-2.0 + weights provenance OK. Perf: partial (baseline @li ran 2k seq; 4k profile missing). Infra: validated on dedicated pool. Blocker: none from infra side.

li: cedar-7b perf notes — baseline OK at 2k, but we haven't exercised >2048. I can run the 4k sweep but need ~3 hours on a p4d slot. Filing RD-4821 to request quota.

raj: infra ack — dedicated pool has capacity, can carve out 1 slot for the 4k perf run. If you want faster we can schedule during the 4–6pm maintenance window.

maya: @li please book the slot and post logs here when done. If you hit KV cache growth, ping @danny immediately.

sarah-legal: saffron-1.2 — license flagged. Model was trained with mixed-sourced data; third-party weights vendor requires a signed attestation for commercial hosting. I've created ticket LEG-2148 and requested vendor contact. Until we get that, saffron-1.2 should be marked "restricted" in catalog metadata (no hosted API).

felix: I've opened PR #489 to add sample prompts + eval fixtures for cedar-7b and saffron-1.2: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/models/pulls/489. Also added smoke evals for latency/quality. Can reviewers pls take a quick look? :eyes:

ana-product: quick question on rollout % — product recommends 5% canary for cedar-7b with automatic rollback on error rate >1.5% or latency p50 > 250ms. Thoughts?

danny: runtime note — cedar-7b passes steady-state but we saw KV cache blowup on one long-doc trace during staging canary (PR #472). Short-term mitigation: reduce target batch_size from 16 to 8 and enable streaming for long responses. Command I used for repro:```bash
python perf/run_harness.py --model cedar-7b --seq 4096 --batch 16
```Switching to `--batch 8` keeps memory stable.

owen: ack @danny — will make a config override for canary (batch=8 + streaming). I'll add a fallback model: cedar-3b-quantized for requests that exceed 3k tokens.

maya: deploy-bot, what's the canary schedule?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @maya for 2026-03-18T10:00Z. Targets: cedar-7b on dedicated pool, 5% traffic, auto-rollback configured. Logs will be posted to #eng-releases/canary-cedar-7b.

li: I'll start the 4k perf run during the 4pm window (RD-4821). Will paste results to this thread when finished.

maya: Summary / action items: 
- @owen: add fallback model config (cedar-3b-quantized) to the rollout PR.
- @li: run 4k perf, post logs (RD-4821).
- @danny: add runtime override (batch=8 + streaming) for canary.
- @sarah-legal: follow up on LEG-2148 and update saffron-1.2 metadata to `restricted` until cleared.
- @felix: ping reviewers on PR #489, link the smoke evals from the release checklist.
- @ana-product: confirm canary metrics and escalation path in the launch doc.

Please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve picked up an action. I’ll compile these into the launch handoff and post a short checklist in #eng-releases.

owen: :thumbsup: picked up fallback config.
li: :thumbsup: running tests now.
danny: :thumbsup: will push runtime override in a sec (PR #493).
sarah-legal: :thumbsup: starting vendor outreach.
felix: :thumbsup: will ping reviewers.

maya: Thanks everyone — will post the compiled checklist by EOD.
